content.text: I'll create a U-shaped profile with the specified dimensions. Let me start by calculating the necessary coordinates for the blocks that will form this shape.

input.PythonCode:
# U-shaped profile dimensions
width = 70  # mm
height = 40  # mm
web_thickness = 5  # mm
length = 450  # mm

# Calculate the positions and sizes for the three blocks that form the U-shape
# We'll create one main block and subtract two blocks to form the U-shape

# Main block (the entire profile)
main_block_x = 0
main_block_y = 0
main_block_z = 0
main_block_x_size = width
main_block_y_size = length
main_block_z_size = height

# First subtraction block (left inner cavity)
sub1_x = web_thickness
sub1_y = 0
sub1_z = web_thickness
sub1_x_size = (width - 3 * web_thickness) / 2  # Half of the inner width
sub1_y_size = length
sub1_z_size = height - web_thickness

# Second subtraction block (right inner cavity)
sub2_x = sub1_x + sub1_x_size + web_thickness  # Position after left cavity and middle web
sub2_y = 0
sub2_z = web_thickness
sub2_x_size = (width - 3 * web_thickness) / 2  # Half of the inner width
sub2_y_size = length
sub2_z_size = height - web_thickness

print(f"Main block: x={main_block_x}, y={main_block_y}, z={main_block_z}")
print(f"Main block size: x_size={main_block_x_size}, y_size={main_block_y_size}, z_size={main_block_z_size}")
print(f"\nSubtraction 1: x={sub1_x}, y={sub1_y}, z={sub1_z}")
print(f"Subtraction 1 size: x_size={sub1_x_size}, y_size={sub1_y_size}, z_size={sub1_z_size}")
print(f"\nSubtraction 2: x={sub2_x}, y={sub2_y}, z={sub2_z}")
print(f"Subtraction 2 size: x_size={sub2_x_size}, y_size={sub2_y_size}, z_size={sub2_z_size}")

# Verify dimensions
print(f"\nVerification:")
print(f"Total width: {width} mm")
print(f"Web thickness: {web_thickness} mm")
print(f"Inner cavity width: {sub1_x_size} mm each")
print(f"Total inner width: {2 * sub1_x_size + web_thickness} = {2 * sub1_x_size + web_thickness} mm")
print(f"Wall thickness check: {sub1_x} mm (left), {web_thickness} mm (center), {width - sub2_x - sub2_x_size} mm (right)")
